title: ANU Vice-Chancellor's International Achievement Award

duration: Embassy Recommendation: irregular course within 2 years; regular course: standard school year (when necessary, 6 months preliminary education will be added)

title: GKS (Global Korea Scholarship) Program - Undergraduate Degree Programs
official_source: National Institute for International Education (NIIED), Ministry of Education, Republic of Korea
duration: Korean language training (1 year) + associate degree programs (2-3 years), bachelor's degree programs (4-6 years)
description: The Korean government-invited scholarship degree programme that funds a year of Korean language training followed by an associate degree (2-3 years) or bachelor's degree (4-6 years) at a designated GKS university in Korea. The published benefits list is airfare, Korean language training fees, tuition and monthly allowances. Selection runs through two routes: an Embassy Track that applies through the Korean embassy/consulate, and a University Track in which the student applies directly to a GKS-designated university (UIC specialisation and Associate Degree).

title: ICSSR Participation in International Seminar Abroad (Travel Grant Scheme)
degree: Doctoral, Postdoctoral, Research (faculty and doctoral/postdoctoral scholars)
official_source: Indian Council of Social Science Research (ICSSR), Ministry of Education, Government of India
duration: Period of stay abroad not exceeding the actual days of the conference plus travel dates
description: This scheme gives partial financial assistance to Indian social science scholars who have been formally invited to present a paper at an international conference abroad. Assistance covers air travel, visa fee, travel insurance, local conveyance, maintenance for the stay, and registration fee up to US$200. Regular faculty receive up to 50 percent of the total cost of the visit, while SC/ST faculty, persons with benchmark disability, and postgraduate/doctoral/postdoctoral researchers without salary protection may be considered for the full cost of the visit.

degree: Doctoral, Postdoctoral, Research (faculty and Ph.D/PDF scholars)

description: The ICSSR provides financial assistance to Indian social science scholars who need to travel abroad for data collection or to consult archival material in connection with their research. title: University of Sharjah Research Assistant (RA) and Teaching Assistant (TA) Scholarship for Master's Students
duration: Tied to enrolment in a full master's degree programme; continuation is subject to the bylaws and regulations of the University of Sharjah. No scholarship duration is published.
description: The University of Sharjah offers work-based Research Assistant and Teaching Assistant scholarships to eligible master's students, who must commit 20 hours per week at the University and may not be employed elsewhere during the scholarship period. The award is awarded by the concerned academic department based on its academic and research needs and available opportunities. The official page read does not publish the benefit amount, whether tuition is waived, or any list of expenses the scholarship covers, so this record is deliberately left unquantified rather than assumed to be full funding.
